comments.text:
As someone from the southwest coast of BC, I always forget how different our baseline is. When the video says Southern Ontario has a “mild climate,” that’s true for Canada — the Great Lakes keep it warmer than the Prairies or Northern Ontario, and the growing season is long enough for peaches and vineyards.

But from a coastal BC perspective, Ontario doesn’t feel mild at all. Our winters barely dip below freezing, we get almost no snow, and the Pacific keeps everything stable. Ontario’s freeze–thaw cycles, humidity, and hot summers feel extreme compared to the coast.

So yeah — mild for Canada, not mild for BC folks.
